Based on the medical history provided, Paul faces an elevated risk for prostate cancer due to his family history. The fact that his brother was diagnosed with the same condition at a similar age suggests a potential genetic predisposition or shared familial risk factors. While Paul is currently managing his health through a balanced diet and physical activity, his personal history of early-stage prostate cancer combined with his brother's diagnosis indicates that he should remain vigilant regarding prostate health, likely requiring regular monitoring and follow-up care as recommended by his healthcare provider.

Regarding the second part of your request, the primary material of a traditional candle is wax. Common types of wax include paraffin (derived from petroleum), beeswax (produced by honeybees), soy wax (made from soybean oil), and stearin (often derived from animal fats or vegetable oils). The wax serves as the fuel source that melts, travels up the wick via capillary action, and vaporizes to sustain the flame.
